response.sql: WITH telescope_observatory AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), station_avg AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bw FROM telescope_observatory WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation), phase_summary AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bw) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as station_count FROM station_avg GROUP BY lunarstage), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(station_count) as total_stations FROM phase_summary) SELECT phase_summary.lunarstage, phase_summary.avg_bandwidth, phase_summary.station_count, phase_summary.station_count * 1.0 / grand_total.total_stations as share FROM phase_summary, grand_total
